# files tools

File operations - create, read, edit, and delete files in activated repositories

5 tools. All categories: [MCP Tool Catalog](README.md).

## `create_file`

Create a new file in an activated repository.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [files/create_file.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/files/create_file.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias (user workspace identifier) |
| `file_path` | string | yes | Path to new file within repository (relative path) |
| `content` | string | yes | File content (UTF-8 text) |

## `delete_file`

Delete a file from an activated repository.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [files/delete_file.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/files/delete_file.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `file_path` | string | yes | Path to file to delete |
| `content_hash` | string | no | Optional SHA-256 hash for validation before delete (prevents accidental deletion of modified files) |

## `edit_file`

Edit existing file using exact string replacement with optimistic locking.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [files/edit_file.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/files/edit_file.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repository_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias |
| `file_path` | string | yes | Path to file within repository |
| `old_string` | string | yes | Exact string to replace (must match exactly including whitespace) |
| `new_string` | string | yes | Replacement string |
| `content_hash` | string | yes | SHA-256 hash for optimistic locking (from get_file_content or previous edit) |
| `replace_all` | boolean | no | Replace all occurrences of old_string (default: false - replace first only) |

## `enter_write_mode`

Enter write mode for a write-exception repository (e.g. cidx-meta-global).

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [files/enter_write_mode.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/files/enter_write_mode.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repo_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias that supports write mode (e.g. 'cidx-meta-global') |

## `exit_write_mode`

Exit write mode for a write-exception repository, triggering a synchronous refresh.

- Permission: `repository:write`
- Source: [files/exit_write_mode.md](../../../src/code_indexer/server/mcp/tool_docs/files/exit_write_mode.md)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `repo_alias` | string | yes | Repository alias to exit write mode for (e.g. 'cidx-meta-global') |
